label: F-02
title: Story 103 names the wrong third-party BPT holders (0xE74E.., 0x5f97.., 0xde44.. all hold 0 BPT); the sole non-protocol LP is 0xc65f...e8db with 12,036.97 BPT (37.1%, ~$24.4k), so the plan's 'warn the 37% LP' obligation has no story checkpoint
rootCause: Stale holder list in story 103 L213 (L116).
description: Story 103 L213 says 'BPT held by third parties (0xE74E..1322, 0x5f97..d2, 0xde44..3D07) is out of scope'. On-chain, all three hold 0 BPT. The only non-protocol holder is 0xc65faaafbbda520791f344d33497485edf58e8db, with 12,036.97 BPT: 37.1% of supply, ~10,957 sUSDS + ~13,309 phUSD, ~$24.4k. BalancerWinddownPlan.md L62-65 and open question #1 (L531, 'Known to the owner, who will contact them directly') identify that holder, but story 103 never names them. The cutover itself is FAIR to this LP. The protocol's proportional exit leaves the per-BPT claim unchanged: Balancer rounds in the pool's favour, so remaining LPs gain dust. It leaves the spot price unchanged (both balances x0.371). Recovery-mode exit after the 30 Oct pause is also proportional. After the cutover, 0xc65f is the SOLE LP of a 0.3%-fee pool at the old price, and Stage-4 pool() lifts on the V2 pair will be arbitraged into it until it pauses (ledgered as ycn Q-25 b4c10f0f8938: $8-$11).
impact: None from the cutover's mechanics. The risk is procedural. The story's out-of-scope bullet points the verify/report step at the wrong addresses, so the plan's 'warn the 37% LP' obligation has no story checkpoint.
assetImpact: None; the cutover is mechanically fair to the remaining LP (proportional exit). Procedural: the 'warn the 37% LP' obligation (plan L62-65, L531) has no story checkpoint and names the wrong holders.
recommendation: Amend story 103's third-party bullet to name 0xc65f (12,036.97 BPT at block 26181448). Have verify print the post-cutover holder set of the Balancer pool.
